verdict.rationale: Caveman Cloud gives agents their own Linux desktop and browser on a Cloud computer to check their work, which is a product-provided separate environment for testing. The docs never call it a sandbox, describe isolation guarantees, or say it keeps production data out of reach. Request-based tests and masking guardrails are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented sandbox/test mode isolated from production data, explicit isolation or data-separation guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: On a Cloud computer an agent drives a Linux desktop and a browser to check its own work.
